# IFLA Standards Documentation - Issue Reporting Guide

## Quick Guide for Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)

Thank you for helping improve the IFLA Standards documentation! This guide shows you how to report issues with the documentation sites.

### How to Report an Issue

1. **Find a Problem**: While reading any IFLA standards documentation page, if you notice:
   - Missing pages or content
   - Formatting or display problems  
   - Broken links or incorrect information
   - Navigation issues
   - Incorrect metadata

2. **Click "Edit this page"**: Look for the "Edit this page" link at the bottom of any documentation page

3. **Choose Your Action**: A popup will appear with two options:
   - **"Edit on GitHub"** - Make changes directly (requires GitHub account)
   - **"Report an Issue"** - Let others know about the problem (recommended for most users)

4. **Fill Out the Issue Form**: If you chose "Report an Issue", you'll see a form with:
   - **Page URL**: Already filled in for you
   - **Type of Problem**: Select from dropdown (missing content, formatting, etc.)
   - **Description**: Explain what you found and what you expected
   - **Steps to Reproduce**: If applicable, describe how to see the problem
   - **Additional Context**: Any other helpful information

### What Happens Next?

- Your issue will be labeled with the site name (e.g., ISBDM, LRM)
- The documentation team will review and respond
- You'll get email notifications about updates to your issue
- Most issues are addressed within 1-2 weeks

### Types of Issues to Report

**✅ Good to Report:**
- "The vocabulary table on page X is missing several terms"
- "The link to the RDF download doesn't work"
- "Page title shows wrong standard name"
- "Navigation menu doesn't include the new section"
- "Table formatting is broken on mobile"

**❌ Not for This System:**
- Questions about the standards content itself (use IFLA website)
- Requests for new standards or major changes
- General IFLA inquiries (use IFLA contact page)

### Need Help?

- **Documentation Issues**: Use the "Report an Issue" button
- **Standards Content Questions**: Visit [IFLA Standards Program](https://www.ifla.org/programmes/ifla-standards/)
- **General IFLA Support**: Visit [IFLA Contact Page](https://www.ifla.org/contact/)

### Tips for Good Issue Reports

1. **Be Specific**: "The definition for term X is missing" vs "Something is wrong"
2. **Include Context**: What page, what section, what did you expect to see?
3. **Check First**: Look around to see if the information might be elsewhere
4. **One Issue Per Report**: Don't bundle multiple unrelated problems

Thank you for helping make the IFLA Standards documentation better! 📚
